title: Travis Walton was dead and revived

tellings.quote: In Dr. in um Travis Walton's case, Dr. Leer thinks he or he was dead and they brought him back to life.

plain: Travis Walton, a man who said he was taken by a UFO in Arizona in 1975, may actually have died and been brought back to life, according to the doctor Roger Leir, who studied objects he believed were alien implants in people. The scientist Steve Colbern, who studies such implants, passes on Leir's view on Michels' show. If true, it would mean whoever took Walton could revive the dead.
